articles.title: Trump cancels rallies in Iowa and Kansas in shift of Republican strategy – live
articles.summary:
The president had been on a campaign blitz in key Republican strongholds but will instead opt for tele-rallies

  • Sign up for the Breaking News US email

Members of Congress sent a scathing letter to federal immigration officials this week demanding answers about conditions inside a Texas immigration jail, as detained immigrants on a prolonged hunger strike claim officials are retaliating against them and threatening them with force-feeding.

A group of seven congressional Democrats sent the letter earlier this week to Markwayne Mullin, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) secretary, and David Venturella, the Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) acting director, protesting about the treatment of hunger strikers.

Vivek Ramaswamy, the Republican nominee for Ohio governor, confirmed on Thursday that his campaign is no longer airing an attack ad that features the estranged mother of his Democratic opponent, Dr Amy Acton.

Donald Trump called again for Democrat Mary Peltola to be criminally prosecuted and disqualified from the Alaska Senate race for her campaign allegedly recruiting a man named Dan Sullivan to run against Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan.

Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed will campaign on Sunday in Detroit with Haley Stevens, the congresswoman he narrowly defeated to win the Democratic party’s nomination in August.

Tom Hoyle, who achieved instant viral fame on Thursday by comparing Trump supporters to a cult in a live interview with Fox News before the president’s rally in South Carolina, was removed from the venue by three Secret Service agents.

articles.title: Five reasons why the US midterms matter for the climate – and your energy bill
articles.summary:
Voters are feeling the pinch of Trump’s anti-climate agenda as energy costs rise, but a shakeup in Congress could shift things

If the polls can be believed, the US could see a blue wave in the midterms, giving Democrats a chance to take back the House and Senate, and gaining up to four governor’s seats.

These wins could give Democrats new power to resist Donald Trump’s anti-climate agenda, and to push forward climate policies at the state level. But if Republicans maintain power, it could further embolden Trump’s “drill baby drill” agenda and leave intact his administration’s latitude to continue dismantling regulatory measures his critics say protect public health and the planet.

articles.title: Families in the US are opting for earlier measles vaccinations amid outbreak
articles.summary:
Parents are opting for a second shot of MMR vaccine sooner, which aligns with guidance in Germany, the UK and France

Measles cases are accelerating in the US, with twice as many confirmed cases as last year, and more parents are opting for earlier vaccination – especially with the second dose of the measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) vaccine, which can be given as soon as four weeks after the first.

Giving the second shot soon after the first aligns with what some other countries, such as Germany, the United Kingdom and France, recommend – and the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) also says it’s an option.

Key contest between incumbent Republican Susan Collins and Democrat Troy Jackson will gauge how voters feel about Trump 2.0 and rising costs

Christian LaMontagne has started slowing his lobster boat down.

The 27-year-old fisher spends longer on the water when out hauling traps in Casco Bay, but the trade-off helps him save fuel at a time when costs have surged. Before the US war with Iran began in late February, filling his tank cost about $350 a week. Now it’s doubled to nearly $700.

Domácí bezpečnostní složky navíc řeší významný únik dat a politicky motivované incidenty.
archive.security_status_en: The United States is navigating a period of heightened political polarization ahead of upcoming midterm elections, underscored by tight races in key states and rising cybersecurity concerns. Meanwhile, markets are evaluating persistent structural weaknesses in an unusual labor market cycle alongside fragile macroeconomic growth. Additionally, domestic security agencies are addressing a major data leak and politically motivated incidents.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech budou trhy pod vlivem blížících se mezidobých voleb a výsledků HDP vykazovat zvýšenou volatilitu a opatrnost investorů.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets will exhibit increased volatility and investor caution driven by the approaching midterm elections and GDP results.

archive.security_status_cs: Americká politická scéna je silně napjatá kvůli blížícím se mezidobým volbám, rekordní účasti v předčasném hlasování a sporům ohledně volebních procesů na Aljašce a v Kalifornii. Finanční trhy čelí tlakům v technologickém sektoru kvůli obavám z dopadů umělé inteligence a slabším výsledkům některých velkých společností. Domácí bezpečnostní situace zůstává stabilní, přičemž pozornost se soustředí na politické kampaně a rétoriku kandidátů.
archive.security_status_en: The U.S. political scene is highly tense due to approaching midterm elections, record early voting turnout, and disputes over electoral processes in Alaska and California. Financial markets are facing pressures in the technology sector over AI-related concerns and weaker earnings from major corporations. The domestic security situation remains stable, with focus concentrated on political campaigns and candidate rhetoric.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu trhů spojenou s vyvrcholením volební kampaně a zveřejňováním dalších ekonomických dat.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued market volatility is expected due to the culmination of the election campaign and the release of additional economic data.

archive.security_status_cs: Spojené státy čelí vyvrcholení kampaně před velmi drahými a napjatými kongresovými volbami, přičemž Wall Street se připravuje na možný 'modrý den' a posílení Demokratů. Mezinárodní napětí mezitím roste v souvislosti s obavami ohledně Hormuzského průlivu a událostí na Blízkém východě, což vyvolává nervozitu na trzích s energiemi. Domácí politická scéna je poznamenána ostrými střety ohledně integrity voleb, právních sporů a kontroverzí kolem kampaní v klíčových státech.
archive.security_status_en: The United States is facing the culmination of the campaign ahead of extremely expensive and tense midterm elections, with Wall Street bracing for potential Democratic gains. Meanwhile, international tensions are escalating amid concerns over the Strait of Hormuz and developments in the Middle East, triggering nervousness in energy markets. The domestic political landscape remains marked by fierce clashes over election integrity, legal disputes, and campaign controversies in key states.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává maximální volatilita spojená s průběhem a výsledky úterních midterms voleb a vývojem v Hormuzském průlivu.
archive.forecast_en: Maximum volatility is expected over the coming days, driven by Tuesday's midterm election results and developments in the Strait of Hormuz.
